files.name: proposal.gno
files.body:
package main

import (
	"gno.land/r/gov/dao"
	valset "gno.land/r/sys/validators/v0"
)

func main(cur realm) {
	r := valset.NewValidatorProposalRequest(
		cross(cur),
		[]valset.ValoperChange{
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1342p4lqh94s8qrk48vz2x6nlh3p2hqx4zaq7sp"), 20),
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g13tx3jp4spy90dtpyxr7gjp2mfgvjnfxr7kt3ue"), 20),
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1mndkvypn3339m6yvkyutal5hk6m2yeqp5d52ly"), 20),
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1plf3fmy0h4395jcxxh63g7mzeypr06f9yrdk4d"), 20),
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1982jsr4msdppq0azc3qhf80ngkrsjyqmhc2mej"), 20),
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1sa6j3vy8e04c95nqxsw0gpy9ktkye63yafk79e"), 20),
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1cm5z4slw83sa3x0gttkvv64nx5dc39n2yxk296"), 20),
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1vcwp9c4yqjxuxqtfaq3ehx8czrqam2k9c83w9d"), 20),
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1l3fmz59rw8l6h29hslxt6gtna3th8s7m5vl88d"), 20),
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g138mdf0gqzue3ra2r335upclngn8t8r0n72cn3h"), 20),
		},
		"Add 10 validators to the valset",
		"Add AviaOne, MictoNode, Cumulo, PRO Delegators, UTSA, Cogwheel, VinjanInc, HazenNetworkSolutions, ruangnode and tanjira to the valset at voting power 20 each. Together they hold 200 of the 620 total, less than 1/3, so blocks keep committing even if none of them signs.",
	)
	pid := dao.MustCreateProposal(cross(cur), r)
	dao.MustVoteOnProposalSimple(cross(cur), int64(pid), "YES")
}
